steps.body: {"persona": "qa", "prompt": "Observe whether this task's real run is genuinely green (do NOT change anything, this is an OBSERVE-only check): ${taskHint}\n\nReport what a real test/build run actually showed, and whether the evidence matches the task's own oracle.", "json_schema": {"type": "object", "properties": {"observed_notes": {"type": "string"}, "matches_oracle": {"type": "boolean"}}, "required": ["observed_notes", "matches_oracle"]}, "rubric": "", "model": "haiku", "max_budget_usd": 0.5, "max_turns": 4, "task_id": "${taskId}"}
